capabilities: Parse code blocks in notes for @class, @function and @call keywords
Extract class and method call relationships from code comments
Draw graphs of method call links
Display the generated graphs in an Obsidian canvas alongside the code blocks
disambiguation: Not a code editor or linter; it only visualizes call links declared via comment keywords in code blocks.
extras: A Chinese-language documentation link is referenced but its content is not included; usage relies on comment keyword annotations inside code blocks.
problem: Reading code inside notes gives no view of how methods call each other, so call relationships must be traced by hand.
summary: Code call-graph plugin that parses annotated code blocks in notes and draws method call-link graphs on an Obsidian canvas.
